Should you have any comments, questions or suggestions regarding the current rules, please comment below.

  • Every post must be anime-related. Anything not related to anime will be removed. Meta posts belong in /v/MetaAnime.

  • If the content of your post contains spoilers, add a [Spoilers] tag before the title. Mark spoilers in comments using the appropriate syntax: [DisplayedText](#s "SpoilerGoesHere")

  • When starting a discussion, include the word "Discussion" in either the title or a tag at the end.

  • For recommendation posts, add a [Recommend] tag followed by the name of the anime in the title.

  • Fan art posts must be self posts with a [FANART] tag in the title; a source link must be included within the post.

  • No meme or image macro comments/posts.

  • No "What is your favorite anime?" or "Top X [Something]" posts outside of megathreads.

Cosplay post should be treated the sameway as fanart post, they should be in self post and credited to prevent karma whoring.

Also about the no Memes/image macro in comments seems a bit harsh. They should definitely not be allowed in posts but comments should allow them, look at the comment faces at /r/anime which are basically image macros.

Haven't made a new post in /v/MetaAnime, though if you check /v/anime's current set of rules, I removed the "comments" part of that rule. Just added it in when I wrote it and didn't think much of it at the time, but you're right, that's going too harsh on the content though it may be 'low-effort'.

Link posts and self posts are consolidated into Submission Contribution Points (SCP) on Voat. The purpose isn't to combat 'point whoring', but rather to make people visit the comment section instead of simply expanding a direct image link since those posts are easily consumable and would eventually dominate the front page due to people naturally tending to upvoat 'quickly viewable' content more. We're actually testing a different approach to this and will announce it pretty soon.

And about the comment faces... we've chosen not to implement those, or rather, they're not planned at this moment. There are some in /v/MetaAnime though, 'cause I needed Gorilla-chan somewhere :p
